stories.headline: EU Leaders Face Gridlock Over New Climate Levy Implementation
stories.summary: European Union summit ends without agreement on a controversial carbon border adjustment mechanism, threatening bloc unity and climate targets.

stories.headline: Major Breakthrough in AI Ethics Framework Adopted by Tech Giants
stories.summary: Leading global tech companies agree on a unified ethical AI development framework, aiming to prevent misuse and foster responsible innovation.

stories.headline: New Malaria Vaccine Shows Promising Efficacy in African Trials
stories.summary: Phase 3 clinical trials for a novel malaria vaccine in several African nations report over 90% efficacy, offering hope against a major killer.

stories.headline: Asian Markets Dip Amidst Concerns Over Chinese Property Sector Debt
stories.summary: Major Asian stock exchanges experienced declines following renewed fears regarding the stability of China's heavily indebted real estate market.

stories.headline: Severe Hurricane Hits Caribbean, Causes Widespread Damage
stories.summary: A Category 4 hurricane made landfall in the Eastern Caribbean, leading to extensive infrastructure damage and humanitarian concerns across multiple islands.
